claim: Compagnie des Bateaux du Lac d'Annecy runs sightseeing cruises from the town-center quays at 2 place aux bois: Discovery 1h Big Lake from €19/adult, Heart of the Lake 1h15 from €20.50, Escape 1h30 Big & Small Lake €22, all departing March-November.
quote: Discovery 1h - Big Lake: 1 hour, €19/adult; Escape 1h30 - Big & Small Lake: 1 hour 30 minutes, €22/adult. All cruises depart from 2 place aux bois 74000 Annecy

claim: The Compagnie des Bateaux operates dinner cruises aboard the MS Libellule with packages including the Escapade at €59, Dragonfly at €66.60, Couronne de Savoie at €91.50, and a children's P'tit Mousse at €21.90.
quote: MS Libellule dinner packages: Escapade €59, Dragonfly €66.60, Couronne de Savoie €91.50, P'tit Mousse children €21.90

claim: Plage d'Albigny and Plage des Marquisats are free supervised beaches; Albigny is the largest beach in Annecy with snacks and free toilets, while paid beaches like Menthon-Saint-Bernard and Saint-Jorioz operate mainly July-August.
quote: Free Beaches: Albigny - the largest beach in Annecy with snacks, ice cream, and free toilets, Supervised. Marquisats - 2km from city center with snack bar and free toilets, Supervised.

claim: Plage des Marquisats sits on the western shore near the old town, a stretch of grass and concrete steps; a 2024 upgrade added disability access with ramps, floating wheelchairs, adapted changing rooms and sound guidance.
quote: Inaugurated in July 2024, this social innovation provides access for people with disabilities thanks to special facilities: access ramps, floating wheelchairs, adapted changing rooms and sound guidance.

claim: Plage d'Albigny is the best free beach for families, with water that stays shallow far from shore and a large grass area, supervised July-August 11am-7pm.
quote: best free beach for families with children, with water that stays very shallow for a long distance from the shore... Daytime supervision is provided in July and August from 11am to 7pm.

claim: La Crique rents SUP from €14/hr (single) or €24/2hr, kayaks from €14/hr single and €18/hr double, and pedal boats from €14/30min, operating June-September with departures 10am-6pm.
quote: Single board €14/1hr, €24/2hr; Single kayak €14/1hr; Pedal Boat 2-person €14/30min, €20/1hr. All rentals operate June to September with departures between 10am-6pm.

claim: Le Deck de Veyrier in Veyrier-du-Lac rents 8-seater electric GoBoats requiring no license, plus a piloted electric boat for private cruises, open 4 May to 31 October 2026.
quote: GoBoats accommodate 8 passengers and require no license to operate... 100% electrically powered. Open May 4 through October 31, 2026.

claim: License-free self-drive 6-seater boats rent for €190 morning (9am-1pm), €230 afternoon (1:30-5:30pm), €190 evening, and €370 full day around Lake Annecy.
quote: boats without a license, 6-seater: Morning (9am-1pm) €190, Afternoon (1:30pm-5:30pm) €230, Evening (6pm-8:30pm) €190, Full day (9am-5:30pm) €370

claim: The Jardins de l'Europe is a free 3-hectare English-style lakeside park between the old town and the lake, featuring the Berthollet statue, Ile aux Cygnes, remarkable trees, and the adjacent Pont des Amours over the Canal du Vasse.
quote: a 3-hectare English garden, ideally located between Annecy's old town and its lake... Points of interest include the statue of the chemist Berthollet, the famous Pont des Amours, the Ile aux Cygnes and remarkable trees. Access is free, 24 hours a day.

claim: Lake Annecy water averages 18.8C in June (range 14-25C); early June 2026 measured 21.8C, with comfortable swimming generally from mid-June onward and a wetsuit advisable below 17C.
quote: The average water temperature in Annecy in June is 18.8C, with the warmest water reaching 25C and the coldest 14C... when the water temperature is between 15 and 17C, a wetsuit is recommended.
